groups.example: The groups page of a manager or the superadmin: search by name, create a group, edit its name, its members and its additional roles in one form, and delete groups, as far as the backend allows each row. A superadmin sees one folder per organization, a search at the root spans all of them and is the only list with the organization column, and a group created inside a folder comes with its organization chosen. The demo backend serves no groups, so the list stays empty.
